description:
Many people dream of living off grid, growing their own food & depending on Mother Earth for all things. Alx & I had the same dream for years & decided to make it a reality. In April 2025 we bought a 4 acre homestead in Costa Rica with the plan of building a renewable energy center for solar education and off grid living so other people could come experience what true autonomy is really like. 

While we have much left to do, this is a glimpse into how we are currently living. Homestead life isn’t easy, but it is extremely fulfilling and one day I hope to host all of you here so you can learn to find your free, just like me 🇨🇷🛖🆓 #joefelz #costarica #puravide #homestead #offgrid #selfreliance #freedom #foodforest #motherearth #solar #renewableenergy #prepping #autonomy #freedom #expatlife #agriculture #immigrants #family #dream #lifestyle #ticos #sustainability #farming #aquaponics #aquaculture #chaseyourdream
